preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of different types of ingredients N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**4 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each ingredient quantity A[i] must be between 1 and 10,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if any(A[i] < 2 for i in range(N)) else True
postconditions.description: If any ingredient has less than 2 units, output -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(A) - sum(1 for i in range(N) if A[i] >= 2) + 2 * N)
postconditions.description: Output the maximum number of picks required to guarantee at least two units of each ingredient.
